description: What a supplier delivers as passport evidence: one material declaration per material it supplies. Every supplier on-ramp (file drop, supplier portal, Delta Sharing) lands records of this shape, so the pipeline, the quality rules and the coverage scorecard are the same whichever way the data arrives.
owner: Economic operator (the manufacturer placing the product on the market)

delivery.format: JSON lines, UTF-8, one declaration per line

fields.name: declaration_id
fields.description: The supplier's own identifier for this declaration.

fields.name: supplier_id
fields.description: Supplier identifier issued by the manufacturer at onboarding.

fields.name: recycled_content_pct
fields.description: Share of recycled content by weight, in percent.

fields.name: carbon_kg_co2e_per_kg
fields.description: Declared carbon footprint, kg CO2e per kg of material.

fields.name: certificate_number
fields.description: Number of the certificate backing the declaration.

fields.name: certificate_valid_until
fields.description: Last day the certificate is valid.

fields.name: declared_at
fields.description: Day the supplier issued the declaration.

fields.name: submitted_by
fields.description: Contact address of the person who submitted the declaration.
